messages:
elaine: FYI mkdocs build failing on staging for /guides/model-serving — linkcheck errors for fragment '#Model-Deployment' (CI shows 404)

docs-ci-bot: build failed: linkcheck: '/guides/model-serving#model-deployment' -> 404 (affected pages: /sdk/python, /guides/model-serving)

sam: hmm, that anchor used to be 'Model Deployment' vs 'model-deployment' — looks like slugify rules changed during the mkdocs migration (casefold + punctuation).

maria: saw this too. Many headings lost their explicit ids so the generated slugs differ depending on the mkdocs plugin version.

elaine: minimal fix: add explicit heading id to the docs page, e.g. `## Model Deployment {#model-deployment}` — will sidestep slug differences.

sam: yep. alternatively update incoming links to match new slug but explicit id is safer across toolchains.

elaine: opening tiny PR with explicit ids + a couple link updates to the python SDK page — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5423

docs-ci-bot: PR 5423 triggered preview build: https://preview-docs.redwood/pulls/5423 — linkcheck step started

miguel: quick note: /sdk/python has a camelCase anchor used in an old tutorial (`#ModelDeployment`) — PR should update that link too or it will still 404 on older clients.

elaine: thanks — updated the SDK links in the PR to point to `#model-deployment` and added an explicit id on the target heading.

annika: also saw a case where parentheses in inline link text were messing up the markdown parsing (example: `config (advanced)` -> slug became `config-advanced` vs `config-(advanced)`). I replaced that link with an explicit id to be consistent.

sam: running local linkcheck after pulling elaine's branch...

sam: local linkcheck passes (no broken fragments).

docs-ci-bot: preview build succeeded — linkcheck clean ✅

maria: great. can we add a short note in the migration guide explaining the slug/casefold change so future migrations don't surprise folks?

elaine: +1. i'll add a 3-line section in migration-guide.md in a follow-up PR.

sam: reviewed and left one tiny nit about a duplicate heading id (fixed inline). LGTM otherwise.

sam: approved PR 5423 :thumbsup:

elaine: merging now. thanks all for the quick turnaround.

deploy-bot: merged PR 5423 into main and kicked off production build — build id: prod-20260311-88

deploy-bot: production build completed successfully — no link regressions detected.

maria: thanks everyone :tada: this should stop the 404 noise in the staging channel.

sam: opened INF-204 to track adding an automated rule to detect casefold/slug differences during major migrations. Assigned to eng-infra.

elizabeth: noted and assigned INF-204 to eng-infra for implementation — thanks for filing.

maria: closing thread, will follow up on the migration-guide PR later.
